Name: Stardew QOL
Author: nuyaharu
Description:
[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]
[b]Stardew QOL[/b] is a modular and highly customizable quality-of-life mod for Stardew Valley. Designed to adapt to your playstyle without breaking game balance, it gives you full control over time passage, automatic energy and health regeneration, and dynamic weather frequency. Every module and individual feature can be toggled or fine-tuned in-game at any time.

Stardew QOL tries its best to match your pace.

[b]Note:[/b] This release is designed for [b]singleplayer[/b]. A separate multiplayer version is being worked on.
[b]Source Code & Repository:[/b][url=https://github.com/nuyahr/stardew-qol]GitHub - Stardew QOL[/url]

[line]

[size=5][b]Main Features[/b][/size]

[b]Time Control Module[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Custom Clock Speed:[/b] Adjust how many real-world seconds pass per 10 in-game minutes (from 7.0s up to 720.0s, in 0.5s steps, for much longer, relaxing days). Higher values make the clock slower, while lower values make it faster.[/*]
[*][b]24-Hour Real-Time Cycle:[/b] Play with a true 1:1 real-time day cycle (overrides custom clock speed)[/*]
[*][b]Museum Library Fast-Forward:[/b] Speed up the clock (1.0s to 6.0s per 10 in-game minutes, in 0.5s steps—where fewer seconds means faster clock speed and more seconds means slower than 1.0s) while sitting at the small study tables in the lower area of the Museum Library before 6:00 PM. Includes an optional [b]24h Balance[/b] mode that adjusts the remaining day's clock speed to compensate for time skipped while seated[/*]
[/list]
[b]Automatic Energy Recovery[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Activity-Based Modes:[/b] Configure distinct regeneration amounts and real-world second intervals for [i]General Recovery[/i], [i]While Walking[/i], [i]While Standing Still[/i], [i]While Seated[/i], and [i]While Holding a Fishing Rod[/i]. Only one mode runs at a time to prevent stacking[/*]
[*][b]Real-Time Intervals:[/b] Recovery intervals run on real-world seconds rather than in-game clock speed, so regeneration timing stays consistent regardless of how fast or slow the day passes[/*]
[*][b]Action Cooldown:[/b] Automatically pauses energy regeneration for 1.0s to 3.0s (in 1.0s steps) after performing an action that consumes stamina[/*]
[/list]
[b]Automatic Health Recovery[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Activity-Based Modes:[/b] Independent regeneration amounts and real-world second intervals for [i]General Recovery[/i], [i]While Walking[/i], [i]While Standing Still[/i], and [i]While Seated[/i]. Fractional healing values smoothly accumulate until a full health point is restored[/*]
[*][b]Shared Damage Cooldown:[/b] Taking damage temporarily pauses both Health and Energy regeneration (configurable from 1.0s to 3.0s, in 1.0s steps)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Dynamic Climate Module[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Additional Weather Rolls:[/b] Adds configurable bonus chances (1% up to 75% for Rain and Snow; 1% up to 35% for Storms) on eligible sunny days without replacing or reducing the game's natural weather[/*]
[*][b]Balanced Caps:[/b] Set maximum limits per half-month (resets on the 1st and 15th of each season). Calculated strictly by the in-game calendar so altered clock speeds never cause extra weather rolls[/*]
[/list]
[b]Full Customization & Localization[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Master Toggle & Notifications:[/b] Enable or disable the entire mod or individual modules on the fly without losing your saved settings. Optional HUD notifications let you know when automatic time acceleration starts or ends[/*]
[*][b]Languages Included:[/b] Built-in support for English and Portuguese (PT-BR)[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Required:[/b] [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (4.0.0 or later)[/*]
[*][b]Recommended (Optional):[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] to configure all options easily in-game. If not installed, the mod can still be configured by editing
[code]config.json[/code][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[*]Download [b]Stardew QOL[/b] and extract the ZIP archive[/*]
[*]Move the
[code]StardewQOL[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Author's Note[/b][/size]
Thank you to everyone who downloads the mod ✨

It definitely isn't perfect—far from it—but I tried to give you freedom while keeping it from breaking the game or stripping away the purpose of each system inside it 😮‍💨

Any feedback is very welcome so we can keep improving this 😵‍💫☝🏻. Bug reports or ideas to make it better are always appreciated 😸

Please keep in mind that I might be away for a while depending on my personal situation 😖

Still, thank you so much to everyone who downloads and plays the mod! I tried my best to make it comfortable without taking away the purpose of the original game—just trying to adapt a pace that fits each person

Downloads.Description: Stardew QOL v2.1.0 (Singleplayer). Modular QOL mod for Stardew Valley with clock control, real-time energy/health regen, and bonus weather (EN/PT-BR, GMCM/config.json). Multiplayer version in progress. Requires SMAPI 4.0.0+
